contracts: (Every external-process record has finite output capture and a deterministic terminal state; output-budget exhaustion cannot be successful or reduce coverage.) AND (The authored S30 selector observes a deterministic terminal category for each completion and rejects budget exhaustion as unsuccessful.)

Each declared assertion needs a cer_assertion mapping and a meaningful independent oracle. Tests must invoke the real production entry. The plan is not a behavior observation. Keep governance/constraint failures non-authorizing; do not emit expected-red for them. Preserve all bound Given/When/Then and forbidden outcomes. No placeholder pass or synthetic RED.

selector_intents: Execute the authored S30 bounded-process test with a fixture that produces an otherwise unclassifiable terminal outcome, and observe the behavior test fail until deterministic terminal categorization is implemented.
Run a process whose output exceeds the configured capture limit and require the bounded-execution assertion to reject successful completion.
